remarks:
Welcome to this charming and spacious classic home in the heart of the village of Andover located at 14 E Dyke Street. Built in 1940 with approximately 1,947 sq ft of living space, this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence offers a blend of character, potential and affordability. From the covered front porch perfect for your morning coffee, step inside to discover generous room sizes and natural-light filled spaces—ideal for everyday living and entertaining alike. The first floor features living room, dining room, kitchen with built-in pantry and adjacent mudroom/laundry room, bedroom and half bath. Upstairs you’ll find three bedrooms, one with covered balcony, and a full bath. Outside there is a covered back porch with patio overlooking the backyard that offers outdoor possibilities: a yard for play, gardening or expansion, watching the annual fireworks display, plus a detached garage for convenient off-street parking. Located within the Andover Central School District and nestled in a village of tree-lined streets, this home is just minutes away from local amenities, hospitality and the scenic beauty of Allegany County. Bring your ideas—whether you’re looking to modernize, personalize or simply move right in. HOME BEING OFFERED AS IS! 
SHOWINGS ARE DELAYED UNTIL JULY 6 AND NEGOTIATIONS ARE DELAYED UNTIL JULY 10TH.
